Rows 4-9 are a patterned face-on cushion or panel, and rows 10-14 are a dark base and grey foot strip. No seat plane is visible, so this matches the 'seat: band 2' bad reference (front elevation).

styleAnswer.evidence: The candidate is a low bench-like seat with a pale top highlight strip, an orange-red body carrying a repeating row of panel dots, and a dark red-brown rim. That gives about 5 lightness steps on its main ramp, similar to the bench and hedge references. The measured facts back this up. The median is 11 colours per 16x16 tile, against 10 for the hedge and 17-20 for the stall and well. Flat-fill coverage is 0%. The dark edge pixels are 0% neutral, so the outline is tinted, a dark red-brown that follows the body, not a sticker-style black line. It has 11 distinct colours, close to the bench (14) and hedge (11), which are the nearest simple references. It is a little plainer than the stall and well, but those are much larger multi-material props. Next to the bench and hedge it does not look thinner or flatter.
